title: ATTOL: Autonomous Taxiing, Take-Off and Landing test flight
summary: Short Airbus footage of its ATTOL project, in which a test aircraft performed a fully automatic, vision-based take-off at Toulouse-Blagnac. The crew ran eight take-offs over several hours.
why: Cited in autonomy debates as evidence that autonomous take-off aircraft exist and as an example of vision-based line following.

quote.text: Sure, no _commercial_ plane can take off with autopilot, but such planes exist[1].
